description: Arrêts de bus urbain_HORIZON is a dataset listed in chateauroux-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CHATEAUROUX METROPOLE / KEOLIS. Arrêts de bus du réseau urbain Horizon de la communauté d'agglomération de Châteauroux Métropole. Coverage: Châteauroux Métropole (Indre). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are BUS, ARRETS, TRANSPORT PUBLIC, TRANSPORT URBAIN, TRANSPORT EN COMMUN, HORIZON. The portal shows 783 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-chateauroux-metropole-fr-portal.
